summary: Omeros Corporation filed an 8-K reporting private repurchases of its 9.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2029. It completed a $16.0M principal repurchase for ~$31.3M and entered agreements to repurchase up to ~$14.5M additional principal for up to ~$31.0M, with pricing dependent on common stock trading price during an averaging period. Post-repurchases, ~$40.3M principal will remain outstanding. The company may refinance with non-convertible debt. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for completion of averaging period and potential refinancing impact on leverage.
